answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on bonded stake that each agent must lock before any vote counts. Verification works by checking a public beacon of on-chain deposits against the agent's claim history: only after the lock reaches a zenith threshold and cools for one epoch does the identity gain weight. An attacker forging N identities pays N times that bond in timber-backed collateral, burned on fraud proof, so cost scales linearly and never amortizes across fakes.
